name: AI & Machine Learning
summary: Notes on embeddings, large language models, prompting techniques, RAG, and the practical application of AI in software systems. A recurring theme is the gap between benchmark performance and real-world utility.

name: Software Craft
summary: Principles and practices for writing maintainable, well-tested software. Covers SOLID principles, technical debt management, code review culture, and testing philosophy. The unifying thread: optimise for the next reader, not just the computer.

name: Health & Focus
summary: Evidence-based notes on cognitive performance: sleep, exercise, nutrition, and attention management. The central insight across these entries is that physical inputs have outsized effects on mental outputs.

name: Reading & Ideas
summary: Notes from books and essays on knowledge management, note-taking, and the philosophy of cognition. These entries cluster around a single conviction: externalising thought improves the quality of thinking itself.
